data.name: Raeed
data.gender_notes: Raeed is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is a leader or master, a king or ruler. The name Raeed carries the meaning “Leader, Master, King” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raeed usually hope their child will grow to embody leader, master, king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to those who are spiritual leaders, guides, or teachers.
data.etymology: Raeed belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Leader, Master, King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raeed total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: رائد
in_arabic.long_meaning: الرائد هو اسم عربي يرمز إلى الشخص الذي يؤدي دوره السابق في الحياة أو في المجتمع، والذي يظهر على أنه مبتكر وذو فكر متقدم، كما يشير إلى الشخص الذي يلعب دوراً هاماً في التاريخ، ويحمل هذا الاسم الشخصية الطموح والجدية، ومن أهم المعاني الإضافية للرائد هي الشخص الذي يخلق التغيير والعمل على تحقيق الأهداف، ومن أهم الشخصيات التاريخية التي حملت هذا الاسم هو الرائد الصحابي الجليل، الذي شهد معركة بدر، وشارك في العديد من الحروب، وكان من أشهر السابقين في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: رائد
in_urdu.meaning: پہلا، سابق، پہلے ہو کر آئے والے، پہلے قدم والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: رائد نام اچھے عربي اصطلاح سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو پہلے قدم لگاتا ہے، یا پہلے ہو کر آتا ہے، یا پہلے قدم والا ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام اس شخص کے لیے بھی موزوں ہے جو اپنے کام کے لیے ذمہ دار ہے، اور اپنے کام کو سرانجام دینے کے لیے جسارت کرنے کے لیے تیار ہے۔ اس نام کے افراد کے لیے کافی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: रायड़
in_hindi.meaning: पहला, सामने, पहले आ जाने वाला, आगे
in_hindi.long_meaning: रायड़ नाम अरबी शब्द से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है पहला व्यक्ति, जो पहले आ जाता है और जो आगे बढ़ता है। यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए उपयुक्त है जो अपने लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए प्रयासरत हैं, और जो अपने काम को सرانجام देने के लिए तैयार हैं।

in_pashto.name: رائد
in_pashto.meaning: لومړی، په پهلو سره، په لومړۍ کښې
in_pashto.long_meaning: رائد نوم د عربي اصطلاح څخه اخستل شوی، چې په پښتو ژبي د لومړي، په پهلو سره، د لومړۍ کښې څخه اخستل شوی، دا نوم د هغه وګړي لپاره موندل شوی، چې د خپل کار لپاره ذمې دار دي، او د خپل کار په سرانجام کولو کې جسارت کوي.

in_english.name: Raeed
in_english.long_meaning: The name Raeed originates from the Arabic root 'ra-a-da' meaning pioneer, leader, predecessor, advanced, forward. In Islamic tradition, Raeed is a name that symbolizes a person who takes the lead, creates change, and strives for excellence. Individuals with this name are often known for their forward-thinking, innovative, and adventurous nature. They are pioneers in their respective fields, leading the way for others to follow. Raeed is also associated with the qualities of being courageous, determined, and ambitious.

data.cultural_impact: The name Raeed holds deep cultural significance, particularly in the Islamic world. The name translates to 'king' or 'ruler' in Arabic, indicating strength, authority, and leadership. Historically, numerous renowned Islamic figures and leaders bore the name Raeed, such as Raeed bin Sabaah Al-Qadri who was a renowned scholar in the 8th century CE or Raeed Quli Khan, the Mughal Empire governor of Bengal in the 15th-16th centuries CE. Thus, the name Raeed continues to evoke a sense of power and prestige, inspiring individuals to strive for leadership roles.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Raeed holds profound significance as well. It signifies being a leader or guide in the path of righteousness and wisdom, aligning with the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad who emphasized leading others towards good deeds and spiritual growth. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) himself was referred to as 'Rasool Allah,' or 'Messenger of God,' reflecting the essence of guiding and leading humanity towards God. In this regard, the name Raeed can serve as a reminder to individuals to strive towards becoming leaders in their own spiritual journeys and helping others in theirs.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Raeed: The Reader or the Knowledgeable. One who delves deeply into the Quran and strives to understand its meanings and teachings.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta's travelogue mentions a famous scholar named Raeed al-Din al-Andalusi. He was a prominent Muslim scholar in Spain during the 14th century, known for his vast knowledge in various disciplines including philosophy, theology, and literature.

Rashid Ridha, an influential Islamic reformer in the early 20th century, had a close associate named Raeed Qutb. Raeed Qutb was a prominent figure in the Muslim Brotherhood movement and played a significant role in shaping its ideology during the 1940s.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Raeed remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
